detail.longDescription: https:// corporate.shelly.com/en/news/s helly-group-has-entered-into-an-investment-agreement-with-schneider-electric-on-the-intended-voluntary-public-takeover Hadn't seen it before over here on Mastodon, and it's a recent announcement (from the 24th), so I thought I should share. Unsure what the future will hold for Shelly, but Schneider has a competing, closed-source (AFAIK), more expensive, automation software, so I can't see them allowing both to remain going on for much longer. TL;DR: Shelly is being bought up by Schneider # homelab # selfhosted # selfhosting # homeassistant
